items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed. Retain only the five reversible task-routing metadata repairs; reject the deeppenetrations.com SEO implementation and block production, public-launch, monetization, analytics activation, credential/configuration, dependency, deployment, and security-sensitive exposure changes. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or findings; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; security site facts are unknown across 61 managed sites; authentication boundaries, secrets handling, runtime isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unevidenced. Compliance reports 36 passes, 19 fails, and 6 unknowns. No credential exposure or exploit is evidenced, but missing evidence is not clearance. The five metadata-only repairs are low risk because they change no site behavior, data collection, credentials, configuration, dependencies, production files, or external systems. Exact decision: approve only those five repairs with installed-owner routing validation and rollback to prior metadata; preserve the security and release gate pending a dated evidence matrix.
